title: pm-dispatch: compress the un-ratcheted instruction surface and extend the line ratchet over it — provenance one line, stories live on cards
body:
Filed on maintainer ruling (2026-08-14, verbatim, untranslated): 「8685 字太多了 并且综合审查一下相关的skills是不是应该压缩字数。」 → assessment delivered (numbers below) → 「现在」. Maintainer-pulled, so it outranks the process-class-last ordering rule.

## The measurement that motivates this

One shift (2026-08-13 13:53Z → 2026-08-14): ratchet-protected `SKILL.md` grew **0** lines (686 → 686) while the un-ratcheted files grew **+31% in one day** — references 555 → 725 (+170), `os-dev.md` 391 → 435 (+44). `dispatch-runbook.md` alone: 155 → 263 (**+70%**). The growth is not junk — every section has a ruling behind it — the bloat is a prose style: multi-line provenance + measured-story narrative around each rule, where the norms themselves are half the lines. The ratchet is the only mechanism with a proven 0%-growth record; nothing else has one.

## Deliverables (one PR)

1. **One-time compression pass** over: `references/dispatch-runbook.md` (primary target, ~263+ → ~170), `references/platform-readings.md` (143), `references/review-checklist.md` (95), `references/landing-operations.md` (86), `references/seat-post-protocol.md` (small), `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (435 → trim). Compression rule, applied uniformly: **verbatim maintainer quotes keep (governance record, usually one line); measured-story narratives compress to ONE line; every normative bullet, ⛔ mark, and one-line why survives untouched.** Target: references total back to roughly the shift-start level (~560). ⛔ `SKILL.md` untouched (686/686). ⛔ No semantic change to any rule — this is compression, not revision; if a sentence cannot be shortened without changing what it licenses or forbids, it stays.
2. **Ratchet extension**: extend the existing `check:pm-skill-ratchet` gate to per-file ceilings covering every file in deliverable 1 (plus keeping SKILL.md at 686), ceilings = the post-compression line counts. Same funded-growth discipline: future net additions to any covered file must be paid for in the PR body.
3. **Authoring style rule, one line**, added to the runbook's card-writing section: provenance is one line; stories live on cards, not in operational text.

## Serial constraint

`dispatch-runbook.md` and `seat-post-protocol.md` are held by PR #8685 (compression rework in flight on it now). **This card dispatches only after #8685 merges**, then compresses the post-merge text including #8685's own halved sections. Claimed now per 「现在」; the dispatch fires on the merge event.

## Constraints

Surface is `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` + `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` ⇒ **fable-mandatory** dispatch, **ADR-class** merge path (draft PR, human merge, auto-merge never armed). Gate union after the final commit with quoted HEAD. id-lint discipline holds through the rewrite (no issue numbers in operational text).
